templates.htmlContent:
Xfinity Internet, explained

How gig fiber WiFi actually works

A plain-language guide to the speed, the equipment, the setup, and the price you can count on for five years.

Explore Internet plans

Fast WiFi, minus the jargon

Internet shopping is full of acronyms and asterisks. This guide skips all that. We will walk through what gig speed means for your home, what the xFi Gateway does, how same-day self-install works, and why your price stays put for five years.

Gig-speed fiber, built for a busy home

Gig means up to 1 gigabit per second of download speed, powered by fiber. In everyday terms, that is enough headroom to stream in 4K, jump on video calls, and game online across dozens of devices at the same time, without anyone buffering.

The xFi Gateway does the heavy lifting

The xFi Gateway is your modem and router in one box, included with your plan. It spreads whole-home WiFi to every room and unlocks Advanced Security and parental controls right inside the Xfinity app, so you manage the whole network from your phone.

Online the day you move in

Most Xfinity Internet plans support same-day self-install. Your equipment ships to you, the Xfinity app walks you through each step, and you are usually online in minutes, with no technician visit to schedule and no waiting around.

One price, locked for five years

The 5-year price guarantee locks your base monthly rate for 60 months. There is no annual contract, so you keep the freedom to change or cancel anytime. Even if you move within our service area, your rate comes with you.

Ready when you are

Now that you know how it all fits together, pick the speed that matches your home and get online on your schedule.

See plans in your area

templates.htmlContent:
Same-day self-install

From box to online in about 15 minutes

No technician visit, no waiting around. Follow these steps in the Xfinity app and set up your gig WiFi yourself.

Get started

What you will need

Your xFi Gateway ships to your door, and the Xfinity app guides you through every step. Have your phone, the Gateway, and the included cables handy, then work down the timeline below.

  1. 1

    About 2 minutes

    Download the Xfinity app

    Get the free Xfinity app and sign in with your account. It becomes your setup guide, WiFi dashboard, and support line all in one place.

  2. 2

    About 3 minutes

    Plug in your xFi Gateway

    Connect the Gateway to your cable outlet and power. The lights will blink while it wakes up, and the app shows you exactly which cable goes where.

  3. 3

    About 5 minutes

    Activate your service

    Tap activate in the app. It connects your Gateway to the Xfinity network and turns on your gig-speed WiFi, usually in just a few minutes.

  4. 4

    About 2 minutes

    Name your WiFi and connect

    Create a WiFi name and password, then connect your phone, TV, and everything else. Whole-home coverage kicks in right away.

  5. 5

    Ongoing

    Manage it all from the app

    Turn on Advanced Security, set parental controls, and check your speeds anytime. Your rate is locked with the 5-year price guarantee, so there are no surprises later.

That is it. You are online.

Same-day WiFi, set up on your schedule, with a price that stays the same for five years.

Choose your plan
